_readme: Funding hours Hyperliquid genuinely never settled. Verified absent from the venue's own fundingHistory endpoint, so re-fetching can never fill them. Listed here so scripts/funding_audit.py converges to green instead of alarming forever - an allowlist entry is an acknowledgement, never a way to silence a real defect. Each entry needs a reason and the date it was verified. Signature of a venue event: the same hour missing for EVERY coin listed at that time; a gap on only some coins points at our pipeline instead and must not be added here.
